title: Bitcoin AI Call — 2026-10-15: SELL at 69% Confidence

intro: On October 15, 2026 the QuantAura four-model ensemble published a SELL call on Bitcoin at 69.3 percent confidence.
Bitcoin was trading at $82,230 when the call was made.
days: Twenty-four hours later the price had moved -0.73 percent, so the call was graded incorrect.
A SELL call needs price to move more than 1 percent in its direction within 24 hours to be graded correct.
trend: Going into the day, the public record stood at 29 hits and 42 misses over 71 graded calls, an accuracy of 40.8 percent.
